title: Marked flat scheme lifts and split deformation directions
statement: For schemes $X,S,S\prime$, arrows $f:X\to S$ and $i:S\to S\prime$, a marked flat lift is a scheme $Y\to S\prime$ with a map $j:X\to Y$ giving a cartesian square with $f,i$, and with $Y\to S\prime$ flat. All arrows commute with the projection and marking. Form their isomorphism classes. A marked restriction over $a:U\to X$ is a cartesian square of the marking arrows commuting with the projections; a base change over $S\prime_2\to S\prime_1$ is cartesian on the thickened schemes and fixes the marked fibre. Set $G=f^*i^*\ker(i^\sharp)$; for first-order thickenings this is $f^*\mathcal J$. Let $L$ be the recorded standard sheaf cotangent complex of $f^{-1}\mathcal O_S\to\mathcal O_X$, and define $\operatorname{Ext}^n(L,G)=\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_X)}(L,G[n])$. For a field $k$ and a $k$-module $M$, use the actual trivial square-zero ring $k\oplus M$, its reduction, projection and maps induced by linear maps. The trivial deformation is the cartesian product with this split base. Addition of two deformations is specified by a deformation over $k\oplus(M\times M)$ whose base changes along the two projections and addition give the two inputs and the output. Define $\mathcal O_X\otimes_kM$ by associated module sheafification on $\operatorname{Spec}k$ followed by the recorded tensor pullback, and its coefficient maps by the same functor. Dependencies: [def-pc-scheme], [def-sbc-first-order-thickening], [def-weil-flat-morphism], [def-pc-fibre-product], [def-pc-module-pullback], [lem-trf-affine-cotangent-comparison], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], [def-sc-trivial-square-zero-extension].
